excluded.reservation_status_date: outcome date (set when the booking is resolved)
excluded.assigned_room_type: assigned at check-in, after the prediction point
excluded.booking_changes: accumulates between creation and arrival, not known at creation
excluded.days_in_waiting_list: accumulates after the booking is submitted
excluded.required_car_parking_spaces: typically recorded at arrival; non-zero almost only for arrivals
excluded.total_of_special_requests: can be added or changed after creation
excluded.country: often completed at check-in in the source data (Antonio et al., 2019)
excluded.agent: identifier (334 levels), not a behavioural feature
excluded.arrival_date_year: calendar year; would not transfer to a new deployment period
